01 / In the field

Nature through
my lens.

Small details, passing light, shifting skies. Photography helps me slow down and notice what might otherwise pass by.

These frames are my way of looking at the natural world and the everyday scenes around it. I’m learning to trust the moment, then find a color and composition that feels like my own.

Curious

I’m Himesh Gupta, a Class 12 student at Kendriya Vidyalaya Jhagrakhand. My interests move between creative and technical fields: capturing nature, experimenting with color grading, and writing Python programs. I also enjoy gardening and learning new things. I believe every project is a chance to develop a skill, explore an idea, and understand something better.
